class.name: TrainAIHints
class.brief_description: Configures suggested behavior hints consumed by the AI driver.
class.description: [TrainAIHints] wraps the FIZ [code]AI:[/code] section. These properties are not authoritative vehicle configuration - they are suggestions the AI driver logic may use to decide how to operate the vehicle.

members.member: [code]AI:LocalBrakeAccFactor[/code] Suggested braking force multiplier for the AI driver when using the local (independent) brake.
[code]AI:Pantstate[/code] Suggested pantograph selection for the AI driver.
[code]AI:IdlePantUp[/code] Whether the AI driver should raise the second pantograph while the vehicle is idle.
